motions.name: baffle_removal
motions.scope: Exact native BRep cuts prove initial optical-part containment in a coaxial cylinder extending through the full 50 mm negative-Y translation. Exact native BRep common volumes test this bounding swept cylinder against every remaining fixed part. This certifies continuous positive-volume clearance within the stated tolerance; zero-volume contact is allowed. Input shapes must be valid solids and fasteners must be removed. Physical hardware fit is not verified.
motions.proof: Each initial moving part lies inside the cylinder. Its Y minimum is the minimum initial part Y minus 50 mm, and its Y maximum is -11 mm. Any negative-Y translation from 0 through 50 mm preserves radial containment and remains within these Y limits. Cylinder clearance therefore implies clearance for every translated optical part throughout the continuous path.
